source:
Runway Royale - A Fully 3D Fashion Experience

The moment players join Runway Royale, they step into a breathtaking 3D fashion city filled with towering glass buildings, glowing fountains, moving digital billboards, palm trees swaying in the breeze, and luxury boutiques stretching in every direction. The world feels alive, with birds flying overhead, music echoing through the streets, and NPC fashion models walking around.

At the center of the city is a massive circular runway plaza where every fashion show takes place. Surrounding it are beautiful stores, cafés, photo spots, gardens, and portals leading to different fashion experiences.

Every player has their own private 3D dressing booth. Sliding glass doors close behind them, giving them a stylish space with floor-to-ceiling mirrors, adjustable lighting, makeup stations, clothing racks, rotating platforms, and shelves displaying shoes, handbags, jewelry, and accessories. Players can walk around the booth naturally, zoom in to style details, save outfits, and decorate the room with themes they unlock.

The non-VIP fashion district is enormous, with multiple clothing stores connected by wide streets. Each shop specializes in different styles such as casual, formal, fantasy, sportswear, vintage, beachwear, streetwear, and seasonal fashion. Players physically walk through each boutique, browsing clothing displayed on mannequins and shelves before instantly trying it on.

VIP members unlock access to an exclusive luxury district hidden behind elegant golden gates. Inside are marble floors, sparkling crystal chandeliers, indoor waterfalls, floating displays, and designer collections unavailable anywhere else. Premium gowns shimmer as players move, wings glow softly, accessories sparkle, and exclusive hairstyles feature beautiful animated details. VIP players also enjoy private runways, luxury dressing suites, and relaxing lounges overlooking the city.

Each fashion round begins with a randomly selected theme. Players have five minutes to explore the stores, create the perfect outfit, and add makeup, hairstyles, and accessories before heading to the runway.

The runway itself is a giant 3D stage with moving lights, giant LED screens, smoke effects, fireworks, floating platforms, and dynamic backgrounds that change with every theme. Spotlights follow each model as they confidently walk down the catwalk, strike poses, and show off every angle of their outfit while the audience cheers.

Players vote based on creativity, styling, theme accuracy, and overall presentation. Winners stand on a grand podium while confetti falls, fireworks explode above the city, and giant screens display their names and outfits for everyone to admire.

Outside of competitions, players can explore the city, complete fashion quests, discover hidden collectibles, decorate their dressing booths, take photos in scenic locations, trade accessories, unlock achievements, level up through fashion ranks, and participate in seasonal events that transform the entire world with new decorations, clothing collections, and limited-time experiences.

Runway Royale isn't just a dress-up game-it's a living 3D fashion world where players can explore, create, compete, and express their style in a vibrant city that feels exciting every time they visit.

answers.ask: How large is the city meant to be - a plaza with shops around it, or a district you spend minutes walking across?
answers.answer: Build it as a compact central runway plaza with the main boutiques, cafés, photo spots, gardens, and portals arranged around it; it should feel like a fashion city without requiring minutes of walking between activities.

answers.ask: Are the dressing booths per-player instances or physical rooms in the world, one per slot?
answers.answer: Dressing booths are private per-player instances, accessed from the city, so every player has their own uninterrupted styling and decoration space.

answers.ask: How many players per round, and how is the vote resolved into a winner?
answers.answer: Use up to 10 players per round. After the runway presentations, players vote for other contestants based on the listed criteria, and the player with the highest total votes wins; ties are broken by the highest theme-accuracy score.

- [author] goal — Q: How many players per round, and how is the vote resolved into a winner? A: Use up to 10 players per round. After the runway presentations, players vote for other contestants based on the listed criteria, and the player with the highest total votes wins; ties are broken by the highest theme-accuracy score.

## Enriched image prompt
Create a compact, vibrant 3D fashion city centered on a massive circular runway plaza for up to 10 contestants. Ring the plaza with glass towers, glowing fountains, animated billboards, palm trees, wide streets, main boutiques, cafés, gardens, photo spots, and portals. Make the non-VIP shops enterable and display casual, formal, fantasy, sportswear, vintage, beachwear, streetwear, and seasonal clothing on mannequins and shelves. Behind elegant golden gates, form a luxury VIP zone with marble floors, crystal chandeliers, indoor waterfalls, floating displays, designer collections, private runways, luxury suites, and lounges overlooking the city. The central catwalk has moving lights, giant LED screens, smoke, fireworks, floating platforms, dynamic backdrops, an audience area, and a grand winner podium. Each city access point to a private dressing instance leads to a room with sliding glass doors, floor-to-ceiling mirrors, adjustable lighting, makeup stations, clothing racks, rotating platforms, and shelves for shoes, handbags, jewelry, and accessories. Include NPC fashion models, scenic photo compositions, and hidden collectible alcoves while keeping every main activity close to the plaza.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Roleplay & Avatar Sim because dressing, avatar styling, booth decoration, and fashion expression lead. Entertainment is secondary because the central runway, audience, and city showcase are substantial spaces.

## Shape and preset
Use shared shape `hub-portals`, outside the dominant genre's usual set: the compact fashion city is the hub for private dressing instances and other portal-linked experiences. Keep the Dress Up preset with its social and photo-focused options while substituting this container shape to honor the separate private rooms.

## Config requirements
Use `social-hub`, `vignette-photo`, `landmark-focal`, `spawn-first-reveal`, `teleporter-link`, `building-interior`, `npc-population`, `water-body`, and `gate-progression` for the central plaza, photo spots, runway landmark, city arrival, portals, enterable shops, fashion models, fountains and waterfalls, and VIP golden gates respectively. Use `spectator-bleachers` for the runway audience area. The private booth fixtures, eight named shop styles, stage effects, winner podium, cafés, gardens, and floating displays remain scene-specific image requirements.

## Layout requirements
Place `spawn-first-reveal` at the main street entrance facing the circular runway. Place paired `teleporter-link` markers from the city to each player's private booth instance and at the unspecified fashion-experience portals. Place `npc-population` markers along boutique streets and plaza edges, and `collectible-nodes` in hidden city alcoves. Place up to 10 free-text StartPoints in the runway queue area, one per contestant.

## Layout components
The top-level portal hub contains three defined segments. Central Fashion City is a map with a compact `world-open` plaza, circular runway, shops, cafés, gardens, photo spots, VIP zone, and portals. Private Dressing Booth is a repeatable per-player map with shape `interior-single` and all listed styling fixtures. Runway Plaza is a zone within the city with shape `stage-runway`, audience orientation, floating platforms, LED screens, and podium. Additional fashion-experience portal destinations are separate maps whose shapes remain unspecified rather than invented.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: the compact city circulation, portal endpoints, shop access, VIP gate, runway orientation, and separate booth maps must be authoritative before isometric dressing.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is medium because detailed booths, boutiques, cafés, and runway features must stay legible in the author-confirmed compact plaza. The theme is colorful stylized luxury fashion futurism. `P4` is required for private booth instances and portal-linked maps, `P3` for city-to-shop interior transitions, `P2` for floating stage displays over lower space, and `CHECK` for fountains and waterfalls.
